---
title: "SG2000 Hints"
---

Notes and slides for working with the Sophgo SG2000 (Milk-V Duo S) in
CS 4250 — Computer Architecture.

## Hints

- [Setup](hints/setup.md) — flash the image, enable passwordless SSH and `sudo`.
- [Running Arduino sketches on the second core](hints/fishwaldo-arduino.md) —
  build a sketch and load it onto the little C906 core via remoteproc.
- [Physical memory access from a sketch](hints/physical-memory.md) —
  why the little core is M-mode/physical, and a test plan for raw DRAM and
  peripheral access.
- [Controlling GPIOs with assembly](hints/gpio-asm.md) —
  drive the J3 pin 7 LED (`XGPIOB18`) from inline RISC-V asm, with and without
  the Arduino core.
- [How a GPIO pin is controlled: Linux, Arduino, `mmap`, and pure asm](hints/gpio-software.md) —
  one pin, four layers of abstraction, as a type-along lecture runbook.
